name: Water quality archive
description: Sampling results for rivers, lakes, estuaries and groundwater, by sampling point and determinand. Derived from the sampling schema, its lineage back to WIMS and its Purview classification.
businessUse: Sampling is not uniform in space or time. Absence of a result is not evidence of absence of a pollutant.
licence: Open Government Licence — covers all staff and contractors
limitations: Sampling is not uniform in space or time. Absence of a result is not evidence of absence of a pollutant.

name: Hydrology flow and level
description: Fifteen-minute and daily river flow, groundwater level and rainfall from the telemetry network.
businessUse: Telemetry gaps during high flow are common; the gauge is often the first thing a flood takes out.
limitations: Telemetry gaps during high flow are common; the gauge is often the first thing a flood takes out.

name: Bathing water sample results
description: Weekly in-season bacterial sampling at designated bathing waters, with the annual classification.
businessUse: Out of season there are no samples. The classification is a four-year rolling calculation, not this week’s water.
limitations: Out of season there are no samples. The classification is a four-year rolling calculation, not this week’s water.

name: Catchment land cover
description: Land cover parcels attributed to water body catchments, used for source apportionment.
businessUse: Classification accuracy varies by habitat; upland mosaics are the weakest class.
licence: Derived product — internal use only, no onward publication
limitations: Classification accuracy varies by habitat; upland mosaics are the weakest class.

name: Rural land parcels
description: Registered land parcels with area, feature and eligibility attributes.
businessUse: Parcels are identifiable to a land holding. Aggregation rules apply before any onward use.
accessRoute: No route in your current role
limitations: Parcels are identifiable to a land holding. Aggregation rules apply before any onward use.

name: Livestock movement records
description: Movements between holdings, used for tracing in a disease outbreak.
businessUse: Registered and reachable, but no consumer has been cleared to call it. Zero use is the honest number, not a gap in telemetry.
accessRoute: No route in your current role
limitations: Registered and reachable, but no consumer has been cleared to call it. Zero use is the honest number, not a gap in telemetry.

name: Waste carrier registrations
description: Registered carriers, brokers and dealers, with registration status and tier.
businessUse: Registration is not a permission to carry any particular waste.
limitations: Registration is not a permission to carry any particular waste.

name: National forest inventory
description: Woodland extent, species composition and structure from the national survey programme.
businessUse: Minimum mappable woodland is half a hectare; small farm copses are systematically absent.
limitations: Minimum mappable woodland is half a hectare; small farm copses are systematically absent.

name: Marine survey catch returns
description: Species, weight and position from research survey tows.
businessUse: Connected through the gateway in June. The clearance decision is with the AI Unit queue.
accessRoute: Connected, not yet cleared for use
limitations: Connected through the gateway in June. The clearance decision is with the AI Unit queue.

name: Flood risk model outputs
description: Modelled depth, extent and likelihood surfaces for fluvial, tidal and surface water sources.
businessUse: Model outputs are scenarios, not forecasts. Using them as a prediction of a specific event is the most common misuse.
licence: Internal use; onward sharing needs the model owner’s agreement
limitations: Model outputs are scenarios, not forecasts. Using them as a prediction of a specific event is the most common misuse.

name: Ammonia emissions grid
description: Modelled ammonia emissions on a 1km grid, apportioned by source sector.
businessUse: Seven years old. Agricultural practice has changed materially since the base year.
limitations: Seven years old. Agricultural practice has changed materially since the base year.

name: Service incidents and tickets
description: Incidents, requests and service metrics from ServiceNow, by assignment group and resolving agent.
businessUse: Individual records identify the agent who resolved a ticket. Nothing below team level leaves the holder.
accessRoute: No direct route in your role. Answers available from the holder.
limitations: Individual records identify the agent who resolved a ticket. Nothing below team level leaves the holder.
minimumAggregation: Team level. No answer is returned covering fewer than 10 people.
askable: Average tickets per person, by directorate, monthly
Median time to resolve, by assignment group

name: Programme and portfolio spend
description: Committed and actual spend by programme, portfolio and directorate, from the finance ledger.
businessUse: Pre-close figures move. A number taken before the ledger closes will not match the one reported afterwards.
accessRoute: No direct route in your role. Answers available from the holder.
limitations: Pre-close figures move. A number taken before the ledger closes will not match the one reported afterwards.
minimumAggregation: Programme level. Nothing is returned that resolves to an individual contract or a named supplier rate.
askable: Average delivery cost per programme, by directorate
Burn rate against plan, by portfolio
Committed versus actual, month on month

name: Endpoint performance telemetry
description: Processor load, memory pressure and device age from the management agent already deployed across the estate.
businessUse: This is organisational signal, not individual monitoring. The distinction is enforced by the minimum aggregation below, not by anyone remembering it.
accessRoute: Aggregate answers only, from the holder.
limitations: This is organisational signal, not individual monitoring. The distinction is enforced by the minimum aggregation below, not by anyone remembering it.
minimumAggregation: Team level, minimum 10 devices. A question that would resolve to fewer is refused, not rounded.
askable: Share of devices below specification, by team
Median processor load during working hours, by portfolio
